repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-task
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin for the Raindrop task service. It registers webex.internal.task, wraps the task REST operations (list, get, create, update, delete, accept, and reject) on catalog service raindrop, encrypts task title and notes with a KMS key before create and update and decrypts them in responses through webex.internal.encryption, and offers register and unregister calls that register the device, connect Mercury, and emit task:registered and task:unregistered without subscribing to any task event.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-task package barrel
public_interfaces.audience: the sibling package webex, which lists this package as a dependency and requires it in src/webex.js
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package also imports the device, encryption, and conversation plugins for their side effects and registers Task as internal plugin 'task' with config {task: {}}. The event-name constants are not re-exported.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.task runtime methods
public_interfaces.audience: SDK plugins and applications that manage Webex tasks
public_interfaces.notes: REST methods resolve the whole response; every method except deleteTask decrypts title and notes in body. createTask and updateTask encrypt the caller's object in place. listenForEvents and stopListeningForEvents are JSDoc-private and empty.

public_interfaces.name: plugin events
public_interfaces.notes: Emitted on the plugin with no payload by register and unregister.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not reuse a task object after passing it to createTask or updateTask.
negative_guidance.why: The encrypt helper replaces title and notes with ciphertext in place, so a retry encrypts them again.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not call updateTask without the task's encryptionKeyUrl when the existing key must be kept.
negative_guidance.why: Without it the helper creates a new unbound key for that update.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not expect task events after register.
negative_guidance.why: listenForEvents is empty; register only registers the device, connects Mercury, and emits task:registered.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the behavioral reference.
negative_guidance.why: It omits registration, encryption, and return shapes. See docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No coverage gate applies: jest-config-legacy sets collectCoverage false and package.json has no coverage script.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question, for example a Raindrop response shape or whether the service binds the created key. Stop and report the gap.
